name: M01-join-KN-to-K
note: join() maps {K,N} to N instead of K (one comparison result flipped)

name: M02-join-KL-to-N
note: join() maps {K,L}/{N,L} to N instead of L

name: M03-join-BQ-to-B
note: join() maps {B,Q} to B instead of Q

name: M04-join_all-empty-to-X
note: join_all() of an empty set is X instead of K (default kind dropped)

name: M05-is_num_const-accepts-bool
note: is_num_const() drops the 'not bool' guard (Constant-value check weakened)

name: M06-request-param-to-X
note: request.param (a fixture parameter value) is treated as unknown

name: M07-boolop-drop-B-branch
note: e_BoolOp drops the B/Q/V/C branch (a boolean predicate in an 'and' is no longer a predicate)

name: M08-existq-B-to-K
note: os.path.exists() returns a constant instead of an existence predicate

name: M09-listq-drop-scandir
note: os.scandir is removed from LIST_Q (a listing call is no longer recognised)

name: M10-cmp-count-not-flagged
note: a count comparison (len(...) == 3) is not a clause-2 violation

name: M11-const-cmp-in-assert-allowed
note: a value comparison inside an assertion is allowed (the assertion-context check is dropped)

name: M12-record-assert-constant-ok
note: an assertion that depends on no path state is not a violation

name: M13-record-assert-unknown-ok
note: an assertion depending on content/value/unknown is not a violation

name: M14-unconditional-fail-ok
note: an unconditional / constant-guarded failure is not a violation

name: M15-open-write-modes-drop-w
note: open() in mode 'w' is no longer write-only (a write is read as content)

name: M16-all-over-listing-allowed
note: all() over a listing is not a universal-quantifier violation

name: M17-try-handler-never-path-state
note: an exception handler never encodes path state (try/except pytest.fail loses its predicate)

name: M18-if-exit-guard-without-exits
note: the 'if <exists>: return' exit guard is set even when the block does not exit

name: M19-for-break-guard-any
note: a break guard is honoured even when the condition is not path state

name: M20-no-assertion-reason-dropped
note: a test with no path assertion is not flagged (the 'no assertion reached' reason is dropped)

name: M21-async-fixture-not-scanned
note: Module._scan drops AsyncFunctionDef: an async fixture is not registered

name: M22-async-test-not-a-unit
note: test_units drops AsyncFunctionDef: an async test is not a test unit

name: M23-decorators-as-body
note: a test's decorators are analysed as body statements

name: M24-parametrize-listing-K
note: a listing-valued parametrize argument is a constant instead of a name

name: M25-elem-listing-to-K
note: the element kind of a listing is a constant instead of a name

name: M26-subscript-pick-is-listing
note: picking a named entry out of a listing stays a listing instead of a name

name: M27-assert-context-flag-off
note: s_Assert does not mark the assertion context (in_assert stays False)

name: M28-implicit-setup-off
note: the implicit setUp/setup_module helper visit is switched off

name: M29-class-chain-no-inheritance
note: the class chain does not follow base classes (an inherited method is not found)

name: M30-module-helper-not-registered
note: a module-level helper is not registered, so calls into it are undefined

name: M31-is_bool_const-any-constant
note: is_bool_const() accepts any Constant as a boolean (the bool-value check is dropped)

name: M32-e_Constant-unknown
note: a literal constant is unknown instead of a known value

name: M33-known-k-modules-drop-os
note: the 'os' module is not a known-value module

name: M34-exist-q-drop-os-path-exists
note: os.path.exists is not an existence query

name: M35-list-m-drop-iterdir
note: Path.iterdir is not a listing method

name: M36-pure-q-drop-pathlib
note: pathlib.Path is not a pure-value constructor

name: M37-membership-not-a-predicate
note: membership over names is not an existence predicate

name: M38-write-count-not-a-count
note: a write that returns a byte count is not a count value

name: M39-mutate-drops-var
note: a mutating call does not update the variable it mutates

name: M40-class-attr-self-only
note: a class attribute is only read from the exact class, not its chain

name: M41-fixture-autouse-dropped
note: an autouse fixture is not run

name: M42-tmp-fixtures-dropped
note: tmp_path/tmpdir are not pure fixtures
